title: The opening
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: The sign is finished. GULLY'S TACKLE & ROAST. Wood is the first regular. He was the first regular before it opened.

panels.composition: The shack, now a shop: the sign finished and hung, hand-painted — GULLY'S TACKLE & ROAST. The espresso machine visible through the window. A crab pot with a menu chalked on a board propped in it. GULLY on a ladder. WOOD below with BARNABY.

characters.pose: on a ladder, hanging the sign

props: chalkboard menu in a crab pot

image.prompt: a shingle shack at a boat launch with a freshly hand-painted sign reading GULLY'S TACKLE & ROAST being hung by a young man on a ladder, a chalkboard menu propped in a crab pot, a young man and a small dog watching below, brush-pen black and white
image.notes: Sign text may be lettered after: GULLY'S TACKLE & ROAST.

panels.composition: The chalkboard: NIGHTCRAWLERS · ESPRESSO · CHOWDER (SAT) · BAIT · DAY-OLD MAPLE BARS. In Gully's block capitals.

image.prompt: close-up of a chalkboard menu in blocky capitals listing bait, espresso, chowder and day-old maple bars, propped inside a crab pot

panels.composition: Inside. The counter. Gully behind it in the apron. Wood on the one stool, the pad out. The first customer is the only customer.

image.prompt: inside a small bait-and-espresso shop, a young man in an apron behind the counter, another on the single stool with a drawing pad, a dog beneath, an empty corkboard on the wall behind the register

panels.composition: Gully pins a torn-off pencil rough — Wood's, from the pad, the sign-hanging — to the corkboard above the register. The first thing on it.

characters.pose: pinning a rough to the corkboard

image.prompt: a young man in an apron pinning a torn-out pencil sketch to an empty corkboard above a shop register, black and white, no words
image.notes: The first item on the corkboard: a pencil rough of Gully hanging the sign. The corkboard fills for twenty-four years.

art.line: brush-pen, committed; xerox; black and white

notes: Gully's opens. The corkboard begins. Wood: the first regular, before there was a shop.
